input_contract: symptom and raw evidence locations
candidate physical-device identity and exact or candidate time window
participating repositories and known artifact information
routes.fallback: If identity, time, or runtime provenance cannot be resolved, preserve the evidence, mark unknown fields, and cap the conclusion at observation_only or candidate_path.

input_contract: feature scope product mode and expected terminal behavior
runtime baseline device identity and exact time window
known producers consumers observations and required scenarios
routes.fallback: If a required edge lacks an observation point, mark it unknown, identify the last positive node and smallest discriminating check, and stop the support claim before that edge.

input_contract: operation entry terminal states and reusable baseline
state owner latch transaction persistence and external side effects
known retry restart replay rollback and failure observations
routes.fallback: If a mandatory replay dimension cannot be executed, mark it unobserved, prohibit a lifecycle pass, and name the smallest safe test required to resolve it.

input_contract: build invocation product architecture root and manifest revision
required repositories modules packages and target device
artifact package deploy and runtime evidence locations
routes.fallback: If any required module cannot be mapped from commit to runtime-loaded object, mark it unresolved and prohibit an aggregate deployment-correct verdict.

input_contract: explicit expected behavior required layers consumers and scenarios
environment device baseline and artifact identity when applicable
test actions observations and evidence locations
output_contract: verdict with allowed and prohibited claims
routes.fallback: If acceptance is ambiguous, preserve partial layer results, mark broader verification blocked, and request only the missing acceptance boundary.

input_contract: producer adapter transport consumer and runtime versions
raw fields values units enums schemas and observed behavior
candidate contract class and available narrow skills
routes.fallback: If a narrow skill is unavailable, preserve the classification and boundary evidence, record the missing route, and perform only a bounded contract comparison without inventing the missing procedure.

input_contract: incident identity date timezone nodes and candidate window
raw sources capture methods and known clock adjustments
available correlation payload state and sequence fields
routes.fallback: If clocks or raw fields cannot be recovered, preserve per-source order, use logical dependencies only, mark cross-source links candidate, and prohibit timestamp-only causality.
